title: Q-KIT-REDTEAM-1: carry REDTEAM-1 into the seed kit
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/autonomy/system.json::not_in_kit
**Status:** open

SYSTEM-SPEC-1: the standing rule REDTEAM-1 (red-team the system's own blind spots) is enforced only by the platform (foundation/redteam.py). A system built from the seed inherits the rule as an instruction but has no code here that enforces it.

Ship the check or loop that enforces REDTEAM-1 into seed/, add its probe to kit_enforcement in seed/autonomy/system.json, and remove REDTEAM-1 from not_in_kit.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cd seed && python3 scripts/system.py --gaps prints no line for REDTEAM-1, and python3 scripts/system.py --check passes.
